gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-fs-public-sans: Public Sans reads hefty and open, with generous bowls. Noto Serif Tibetan sits above it with stubby ascenders and gently thinning curves, so a body size a notch under the heading feels natural.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-fs-supreme: Noto Serif Tibetan carries a literary, refined voice, with diagonals pressed slightly thinner than its verticals. Supreme's dense, open text can go a touch smaller.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-general-sans: Noto Serif Tibetan moves with a gradual weight change, stubby ascenders and a big x-height giving it a literary, refined feel. General Sans follows in smooth, unobstructed curves that carry the eye along like glass tubing, line after line.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-manrope: Noto Serif Tibetan brings a friendly, mild stroke contrast and short, stubby ascenders to the top of the page. Manrope's sans follows, bright and unshaded.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-montserrat: Stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height give Noto Serif Tibetan its literary character, best in large, short lines. Montserrat then glides beneath it, a sans-serif whose lines hold their width through every turn.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-satoshi: Refined and literary, Noto Serif Tibetan dips just slightly in its thin strokes, while Satoshi stands tall with a wide-open e. One excels at gentle modulation; the other at uniform, neon-bright strokes.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-switzer: Soft pressure, stubby shapes, a literary hush: that is Noto Serif Tibetan, with crossbars a bit finer than its stems. Switzer runs on tubular, unshaded strokes and a tall waist line, so paragraphs move along steadily without snagging.
gen-gf-noto-serif-tibetan-work-sans: Noto Serif Tibetan brings stubby ascenders, a big x-height and bowls that thin slightly at the sides. Work Sans, a contemporary sans-serif, carries each stroke at the same visual weight, so long text flows smoothly.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-archivo: Small letters that stand almost as tall as capitals mark Noto Serif Todhri, with a restrained thick and thin look throughout. And Archivo supplies an editorial, outward-opening sans that sits comfortably beneath its modest contrast.
gen-gf-noto-serif-todhri-fs-asap: Noto Serif Todhri is traditional and refined, its mild contrast never turning stark, with small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Asap keeps its open arcs and tall body height steady, so a long stretch of text reads smoothly.
